obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived target with finite correspondence evidence; not a proof
obernants.assumptions: Successful std allocation; exact bounded integer arithmetic; no live external dependencies
obernants.observation_scope: API outputs, errors, insertion IDs or query order; named test outcomes
obernants.operator: Universe: implementations paired with normal/panic outcomes on the fixed fixtures. Normal completion is excluded if a returned value/ID disagrees with direct enumeration, if a tie selects a later ID, or boundary errors/cap state preservation differ. Unsampled implementations remain unconstrained.
